headline: The Sindh government on Thursday suspended Sindh Building Control Authority Director General Waseem Shamshad, East Deputy Commissioner Nasrullah Abbasi, East SSP Zubair Sheikh and 16 SBCA officials over alleged negligence after a six-storey under-construction building collapsed in Karachi's Admin Society near Baloch Colony on Wednesday, killing at least three people and injuring 14, Geo News reports.

card.desc: DC East aur SSP East bhi suspend, maalik ki giraftari ka hukm

caption:
Karachi building hadse par Sindh hukumat ka bara action! 🏗️
Geo News ke mutabiq Sindh hukumat ne Thursday ko Sindh Building Control Authority (SBCA) ke Director General Waseem Shamshad ko laparwahi ke ilzam mein suspend kar diya. East ke Deputy Commissioner Nasrullah Abbasi, SSP East Zubair Sheikh aur SBCA ke 16 afsran bhi suspend kar diye gaye. Yeh faisla Chief Minister Murad Ali Shah ki sadarat mein ijlas mein hua. Wednesday ko Karachi ki Admin Society mein Baloch Colony ke qareeb ek zer-e-tameer chhe manzila imarat gir gayi thi, jis mein kam az kam 3 log jaan se gaye aur 14 zakhmi hue. CM ne building ke maalik aur builder ki fauran giraftari ka hukm diya hai.
Aap ke khayal mein aise hadse kaise roke ja sakte hain? Comment mein batayein 👇
